scope: 23 unchanged ordinary spellcasting-rune primary assignments; existing tags retained and supplemental roles unassessed.
reviewedPrimaryRule: The own exact numeric-ID ordinary non-equipment stackable rune directly pays a named or defined spell requirement. Combination runes replace constituent costs. The full own first paragraph and exact positive function clause must support this use. Ordinary quest access and minigame acquisition do not imply an activity-only copy. Separate Slug Menace imitations and Barbarian Assault/Nightmare Zone copies are outside the exact approved set.
reviewRecord: Root read all 23 own raw named-subject leads, exact item options/state and full material competing use, acquisition and access contexts. Thirteen base runes, six elemental combinations, Astral, Wrath, Sunfire and Aether support their existing Rune/rune/currency-utilities route. Sunfire approval additionally cites the own non-combat spell substitution paragraph; its creation-only lead alone is insufficient. Aether cosmic/soul spell payment is explicit; radiant Oathplate crafting does not erase spell use. Runecraft creation, altar quest requirements, shops, staff charging/infinite alternatives and other uses are retained as context, without exhaustive role claims. Independent exact-source review and separate state replay found no exception in these 23. Five Slug imitations cannot cast ordinary spells; 15 BA and seven Nightmare copies remain separately unresolved. No bankability inference from absent fields, secondary effect or tag claim is approved.

cases.title: Fire rune
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Fire runes''' are one of the four elemental [[runes]]. They are used to cast fire-based combat spells in the [[standard spellbook]], as well as casting many spells from other [[spellbook]]s. Some notable use cases for fire runes include casting [[alchemy spells]] to convert items into [[coins]], charging a [[trident of the seas]] or [[trident of the swamp]], and [[Resurrection spells|resurrecting]] high level [[thrall]]s.

cases.title: Water rune
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Water runes''' are one of the four elemental [[runes]]. They are used to cast water-based combat spells in the [[standard spellbook]], as well as many spells found in other [[spellbook]]s. The [[Confuse]], [[Weaken]], and [[Curse]] spells, often regarded as an inexpensive source of [[Magic]] [[experience]], require water runes in conjunction with [[Body rune|body]] and [[Earth rune|earth]] runes to cast. Some items, such as a [[staff of water]], provide infinite water runes while equipped.

cases.title: Death rune
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Death runes''' are one of the [[runes]] used to cast spells in the [[Magic]] skill. They are required to cast medium-level missile spells, like [[Wind Blast]], [[Water Blast]], [[Earth Blast]], and [[Fire Blast]]. Members with 65 [[Runecraft]] and who have completed [[Mourning's End Part II]] can craft death runes at the [[Death Altar]] by using [[pure essence]] on it, with each essence yielding one death rune. Each death rune yields 10 Runecraft experience. Players with 99 Runecraft will always craft two death runes per essence. Crafting death runes from essence is a requirement for the [[Hard Ardougne Diary]].

cases.title: Cosmic rune
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''cosmic rune''' is a [[Runes|rune]] used primarily in enchanting [[spells]]. Enchanting spells enchant [[jewellery]], such as [[ring]]s and [[amulet]]s, into something that has an effect when worn or operated. For example, when the player casts [[Lvl-4 Enchant]] on a [[diamond ring]], the ring will become a [[ring of life]]. Cosmic runes are also used for the [[Lunar spells]] [[Astral Contact]], [[Cure Me]], [[Cure Group]], and [[Spellbook Swap]] and for the [[resurrection spells]] in the [[Arceuus spellbook]].

cases.title: Astral rune
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Astral runes''' are [[runes]] used in all [[Lunar Spells]]. Astral runes require level 40 [[Runecraft]] to craft. They may be crafted by using [[pure essence]] at the [[Astral Altar]] on [[Lunar Isle]] after the completion of [[Lunar Diplomacy]]. 8.7 Runecraft [[experience]] is gained per essence used. At level 82 Runecraft, players will receive two astral runes per pure essence used.
